bugfix.notes: Regression test pinning the fixed behaviour, with a modeled input when the bug is externally triggered. The fail-before-pass-after class returns to this list once a red run can execute against an exact baseline (per-task worktree isolation).

changed-behavior.notes: New or updated test pins the new contract; affected regression suites rerun.

compose-ui.notes: Shared Compose UI scenarios live in the dedicated uiTest tree; thin platform entries run them on the iOS simulator (kotlin-test) and on the single Android host task under Robolectric (JDK 21, ui-test-manifest). Plain host without Robolectric fails, and CMP 1.10.3 cannot configure withDeviceTest on a Compose module — never request the device lane for compose-ui at this pin.

coroutine-flow.notes: runTest with virtual time: emission order, completion/error/cancellation, no real delay.

datastore.notes: Isolated temp file per test: read/write/remove/clear, malformed stored value, Flow updates.

decompose-navigation.notes: Router serialization, exhaustive direction mapping, result key routing, no replay, single consumer per key.

delete-only.notes: Affected suites plus negative proof the old route/API/resource/symbol no longer exists.

di-composition-root.notes: Generated graph compiles; Koin host verify() and composition-root smoke check the exact module list. Koin verify() is JVM/host evidence only, never Native evidence.

documentation-only.notes: Typed test-not-applicable; docs/link/contract structural gates remain mandatory. A copyable canonical source block is NOT documentation-only.

dto-serialization.notes: Missing field, explicit null, unknown field/value, malformed payload, exact @SerialName contract.

figma-visual.notes: One fresh capture per declared design state; a screenshot never substitutes for behavioral tests when behavior also changed (route the behavior delta through its own change kind).

gradle-build-wiring.notes: Gradle TestKit or generated-fixture configuration and task execution; escalates to the full suite via build-logic-conventions.

ktor-endpoint.notes: MockEngine with request-validating handler: method/path/query/body/headers, 2xx/204, 4xx/5xx mapping, malformed JSON, timeout/cancellation.

manifest-deeplink.notes: Merged-manifest/Info.plist contract proof; platform smoke joins when routing behavior changes.

mapper.notes: Valid input, each required-null separately, optional nulls, unknown enum/key, boundary/time-zone cases; expected values derive from the contract, not the implementation.

new-behavior.notes: Happy path plus at least one relevant negative/boundary case for every new branch/condition/mapping/state transition.

public-api-rename.notes: Compile/contract proof across all consumers plus absence of the old symbol/path.

refactor.notes: Existing suites protect the behavior; uncovered behavior gets a characterization test that passes before and after; assertions never change together with the refactor.

repository-cache.notes: Success side effects, failure without side effects, ordering, reconciliation, cancellation; the repository itself is never mocked.

resource-localization.notes: Key parity, placeholder/format contract, locale compile/resource gate.

room-schema.notes: Real database integration, ordering, FK/cascade, transaction, Flow invalidation; migration proof runs without destructive fallback on both platform lanes.

viewmodel-mvi.notes: Initial state, action-to-state, loader lifetime, error path, direction emission, duplicate/wrong-condition handling.
